chunks: 1837 - And Ali عليه السلام said: “When the month of Ramadan arrived, the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله stood, praised Allah, and extolled Him, then said:”
“O people, Allah has sufficed you against your enemy from among the jinn and humankind, and He said:
‘Call upon Me; I will respond to you.’

And He has promised you a response. Indeed, Allah, Mighty and Majestic, has assigned seventy of His angels to every rebellious devil, so he is not released until this month of yours comes to an end. Indeed, the gates of heaven are opened from its first night. Indeed, supplication in it is accepted.”

key_terms.أَبْوَابُ السَّمَاءِ: the gates of heaven, indicating divine openness and mercy
key_terms.ادْعُونِي: call upon Me; a divine command to make du'a
key_terms.الْإِجَابَةَ: response; Allah’s promise to answer supplication
key_terms.شَهْرُ رَمَضَانَ: the month of Ramadan, the sacred month of fasting
key_terms.شَيْطَانٍ مَرِيدٍ: a rebellious devil, intensely defiant against Allah

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith say about the virtues of Ramadan and the acceptance of du'a in it?
ai.summary: This hadith describes the arrival of Ramadan as a time of divine mercy, protection, and nearness to response. It emphasizes that the month is marked by restrained devils, opened heavenly gates, and the acceptance of du'a, encouraging believers to turn to Allah sincerely.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.1837 - Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) said:
"When the Month of Ramadan arrived, the Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace and blessings be upon him and his family) stood, praised Allah (swt), and glorified Him.

Then He said:
'O people, Allah (swt) has sufficed you against your enemies from among the jinn and humans.
He said, "Call upon Me; I will respond to you," and He has promised you that He will answer.

Know that Allah (swt), the Almighty, has assigned seventy of His angels to every rebellious devil, preventing them from being released until your month concludes.
Be aware that the gates of the heavens are opened from the first night of this month. Know that supplications made in it are accepted.'"
